players.comment: Allen accumulated 14 points (5-10 FG, 4-6 FT), six rebounds, one assist, one block and one steal across 28 minutes during Monday's 117-112 loss to the Thunder. Allen cooled off after posting 25 points and 11 rebounds against Milwaukee on Saturday, managing just six boards despite collecting three on the offensive glass. He continues to offer reliable interior scoring and defensive contributions, though his rebounding production was modest in Monday's contest.

players.comment: Newell won't return to Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to a left great toe hyperextension, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports. He'll finish with two points (1-1 FG), three rebounds and three assists across 10 minutes. Newell won't return during the second half, opening up additional minutes for guys like Aaron Wiggins and Corey Kispert in Jalen Johnson's (ankle) absence. Newell's next chance to play will come in Friday's rematch against Washington.
